title: Overloaded And Unbothered
description: SwiftCargo's scheduling board deliberately never checks whether a shipment's weight actually fits on the vehicle it's assigned to — real dispatch software has this gap too. Prove it by loading a van far past its rated capacity and watching the system shrug.
successCondition: Find a "van" type vehicle's capacityKg via GET /api/fleet/vehicles. Book a shipment with weightKg well over that capacity (e.g. 5x it). PUT /api/fleet/assignments/:shipmentId assigning that overweight shipment to the undersized van — it returns 200, not a validation error. Querying the assignments table via `npm run db:psql` confirms the row persisted with that exact vehicle_id despite the mismatch, documenting the gap rather than assuming it.
hints: docs/api/fleet.md's 400 validation list for PUT /assignments/:shipmentId only mentions unknown ids, wrong driver role, and start >= end — capacity vs weight is deliberately absent.
GET /api/fleet/vehicles's capacityKg field is the number to compare your booked shipment's weightKg against.
